question.en: What happened to the man in the boat?

sentences.en: What happened to the man in the boat?
The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home.
sentences.zh: 威尔河是一条穿过我家附近公园的小河。

sentences.en: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
sentences.zh: 天气晴朗的下午，我喜欢坐在威尔河边。

sentences.en: It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
sentences.zh: 上个星期天天气暖和，于是我和往常一样去河边坐着。

sentences.en: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.
sentences.zh: 一些孩子在河岸上做游戏，河上有人在划船。

sentences.en: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it went towards a passing boat.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个孩子狠狠地踢了一脚球，球朝一条正驶过的小船飞去。

sentences.en: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them.
sentences.zh: 岸上有人朝船里的人喊，但他没听见。

sentences.en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
sentences.zh: 球重重地打在他身上，他差点掉进水里。

sentences.en: I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!
sentences.zh: 我转过身去看那些孩子，却一个也看不见：他们全都跑掉了！

sentences.en: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.
sentences.zh: 那人明白发生了什么事之后笑了起来。

sentences.en: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
sentences.zh: 他朝孩子们喊了一声，把球扔回岸上。
